description: Repairs r-wire/chunk-memo-text-append: Field.FieldSize was invoked as a method (the call kind), refused with 0x800A0CB3 on all rows, so the size question is unanswered. FieldSize is now read with a property get. On a dynaset of SELECT ID, FMemo, FText FROM W over a read-write copy of r-wire-blank: thirteen rows each AddNew, ID = n, AppendChunk on FMemo of: 1 "abc", 2 U+0000 inside, 3 BSTR of 1 byte, 4 BSTR of 3 bytes, 5 lone high surrogate, 6 "ab" then odd BSTR then "cd", 7 UI1 array of four bytes, 8 Null, 9 Empty, 10 Missing, 11 I4, 12 empty BSTR, 13 300 characters; Update with DBEngine.Errors read right after. Rows 21 to 23: AppendChunk on FText of "abc", an odd BSTR and a UI1 array. Then each Memo row re-read through FindFirst with NoMatch, FieldSize (property get, Errors after) and GetChunk(0, 40), FieldSize of the three Text rows, and the table read once. Asks per row the HRESULT of each step, the FieldSize, the stored values and BSTR byte lengths.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
